description.value: Gain proficiency in shields (except tower shields) and when you wield a shield, you can use any polearm or spear of your size as a one-handed weapon. Additionally, while wielding a shield that would prevent your shield-hand from being free, you can attack two-handed with a polearm or spear that you are proficient with at the cost of losing the benefits of that shield until the start of your next turn.
